source: class Ring { public int Value = 7; public List<Ring> Kids = []; }
class RingList { public List<Ring> Rings = []; }
class RingMap { public Dictionary<string, Ring> Rings = {}; }
class FilledList { public List<Ring> Rings = [new()]; }
class FilledMap { public Dictionary<string, Ring> Rings = { "k": new Ring() }; }
class GenericHolder<T> { public List<T> Values = []; }
class Probe {
@storage(allowed: .Session) public static FilledList Filled = new();
@storage(allowed: .Session) public static FilledMap Mapped = new();
@storage(allowed: .Session) public static RingList Kept = new();
@storage(allowed: .Session) public static RingList Other = new();
public static int StoredSelfAdd() { Kept.Rings = [new()]; Ring b = Kept.Rings[0]; b.Kids.Add(b); return b.Kids.Count; }
public static int StoredOtherAdd() { Kept.Rings = [new()]; Ring b = Kept.Rings[0]; Other.Rings.Add(b); return Other.Rings.Count; }
public static int LocalOwnedAdd() { RingList l = new(); l.Rings = [new()]; Ring b = l.Rings[0]; b.Kids.Add(b); return b.Kids.Count; }
public static int InsertOwned() { Kept.Rings = [new()]; Other.Rings.Insert(0, Kept.Rings[0]); return Other.Rings.Count; }
public static int DuplicateOwned() { Kept.Rings = [new()]; Kept.Rings.Add(Kept.Rings[0]); return Kept.Rings.Count; }
public static int ParentlessSelfAdd() { Ring a = new(); a.Kids.Add(a); return a.Kids.Count; }
public static int CloneToOther() { Kept.Rings = [new()]; Other.Rings.Add(Kept.Rings[0].Clone()); return Other.Rings.Count; }
public static int RejectedWriteIsAtomic() { Kept.Rings = [new()]; try { Other.Rings.Add(Kept.Rings[0]); } catch (string message) { } return Kept.Rings.Count * 10 + Other.Rings.Count; }
public static int AssignedAliasStaysLive() { List<Ring> alias = [new()]; Kept.Rings = alias; alias.Add(new()); return Kept.Rings.Count; }
public static int RemoveThenAttach() { Kept.Rings = [new()]; Ring b = Kept.Rings[0]; Kept.Rings.Remove(b); Other.Rings.Add(b); return Other.Rings.Count; }
public static int ReplacementReleasesOwner() { Kept.Rings = [new()]; Ring b = Kept.Rings[0]; Kept.Rings = []; Other.Rings.Add(b); return Other.Rings.Count; }
public static int DictionaryOwnedAdd() { RingMap m = new(); m.Rings = { "k": new Ring() }; Other.Rings.Add(m.Rings["k"]); return Other.Rings.Count; }
public static int ListSelfAssignment() { FilledList f = new(); f.Rings = f.Rings; return f.Rings[0].Value; }
public static int DictionarySelfAssignment() { FilledMap f = new(); f.Rings = f.Rings; return f.Rings["k"].Value; }
public static int OutgoingListAlias() { var before = Filled.Rings; Filled.Rings = [new()]; return before[0].Value; }
public static int OutgoingDictionaryAlias() { var before = Mapped.Rings; Mapped.Rings = { "k": new Ring() }; return before["k"].Value; }
public static int IncomingAliasWrites() { List<Ring> a=[new()]; Kept.Rings=a; a[0].Value=11; Kept.Rings.Add(new()); return a.Count*10+a[0].Value; }
public static int CapturedOutgoingAlias() { List<Ring> a=[new()]; Kept.Rings=a; Kept.Rings=[new()]; a[0].Value=11; a.Add(new()); return a.Count*100+a[0].Value*10+Kept.Rings.Count; }
public static int GenericAlias() { List<Ring> a=[new()]; GenericHolder<Ring> h=new(); h.Values=a; a.Add(new()); return h.Values.Count; }
public static int DictionaryIdentity() { FilledMap f=new(); string before=f.Rings["k"].Id; f.Rings=f.Rings; return f.Rings["k"].Id==before ? 1 : 0; }

public static int RejectedAssignmentThenRetry() { List<Ring> a=[new()]; Kept.Rings=a; try { Other.Rings=a; } catch (string message) { } a.Add(new()); Other.Rings=[new()]; return Kept.Rings.Count*10+Other.Rings.Count; }

public static int RejectedReplacementKeepsAliases() { List<Ring> old=[new()]; Kept.Rings=old; Other.Rings=[new()]; try { Kept.Rings=[Other.Rings[0]]; } catch (string message) { } old.Add(new()); return Kept.Rings.Count*10+Other.Rings.Count; }

public static int FailedFreshPrefixThenRetry() { Other.Rings=[new()]; Ring fresh=new(); List<Ring> a=[fresh,Other.Rings[0]]; try { Kept.Rings=a; } catch (string message) { } Kept.Rings=[fresh]; return Kept.Rings.Count*10+Other.Rings.Count; }
public static int ReplacedClassAliasRelease() { List<Ring> a=[new()]; Kept.Rings=a; Kept.Rings=[]; Other.Rings.Add(a[0]); return Other.Rings[0].Value; }

public static int ScalarIdStaysScalar() { Ring r=new(); List<string> a=[r.Id]; GenericHolder<string> h=new(); h.Values=a; a.Add(r.Id); Other.Rings.Add(r); return h.Values.Count*10+Other.Rings.Count; }
public static int AssignedClassStillOwned() { List<Ring> a=[new()]; Kept.Rings=a; Other.Rings.Add(a[0]); return 0; }
public static int StoredDictionarySelfAssignment() { Mapped.Rings=Mapped.Rings; return Mapped.Rings["k"].Value; }
public static int AssignmentWidth(int count) { List<Ring> a=[]; for(int i=0;i<count;i++) a.Add(new()); Kept.Rings=a; Kept.Rings=[]; return a.Count; }

public static int RejectedReplacementReportsFailure() { List<Ring> old=[new()]; Kept.Rings=old; Other.Rings=[new()]; int caught=0; try { Kept.Rings=[Other.Rings[0]]; } catch (string message) { caught=1; } old.Add(new()); return caught*100+Kept.Rings.Count*10+Other.Rings.Count; }
public static int SetupAtomic() { Kept.Rings=[new()]; Other.Rings=[new()]; return 0; }
public static int RejectStoredReplacement() { Kept.Rings=[Other.Rings[0]]; return 0; }

public static int CapturedFieldMaterializedClosureField() { Filled.Rings=[new() {Value=17}]; var a=Filled.Rings; NeoDelegate<int> read=() => a[0].Value; Filled.Rings=[new() {Value=29}]; return read(); }
public static int CapturedFieldMaterializedPlainField() { Filled.Rings=[new() {Value=17}]; var a=Filled.Rings; Filled.Rings=[new() {Value=29}]; return a[0].Value; }
public static int CapturedFieldClosureFieldNoWrite() { var a=Filled.Rings; NeoDelegate<int> read=() => a[0].Value; return read(); }
public static int CapturedFieldClosureFieldAfterWrite() { Filled.Rings=[new() {Value=29}]; var a=Filled.Rings; NeoDelegate<int> read=() => a[0].Value; return read(); }
public static int CapturedFieldFieldHandle() { var a=Filled.Rings; Filled.Rings=[new() {Value=29}]; return a[0].Value; }
public static int CapturedFieldCapturedLocal() { List<Ring> a=[new() {Value=19}]; Filled.Rings=a; Filled.Rings=[new() {Value=29}]; return a[0].Value; }

public static int CapturedFieldRepeatedReplace() { List<Ring> a=[new() {Value=19}]; Filled.Rings=a; Filled.Rings=[new() {Value=29}]; a.Add(new()); Filled.Rings=[new() {Value=39}]; return a.Count*100+a[0].Value; }
public static int CapturedFieldFieldBeforeLocal() { var p=Filled.Rings; List<Ring> a=[new() {Value=19}]; Filled.Rings=a; Filled.Rings=[new() {Value=29}]; return p[0].Value; }
public static int CapturedFieldFieldAfterLocal() { List<Ring> a=[new() {Value=19}]; Filled.Rings=a; var p=Filled.Rings; Filled.Rings=[new() {Value=29}]; return p[0].Value; }
public static int CapturedFieldClosureField() { var a=Filled.Rings; NeoDelegate<int> read=() => a[0].Value; Filled.Rings=[new() {Value=29}]; return read(); }
public static int CapturedFieldClosureLocal() { List<Ring> a=[new() {Value=19}]; Filled.Rings=a; NeoDelegate<int> read=() => a[0].Value; Filled.Rings=[new() {Value=29}]; return read(); }
public static int CapturedFieldRebindReleased() { List<Ring> a=[new() {Value=19}]; Filled.Rings=a; Filled.Rings=[]; Other.Rings=a; a.Add(new()); return Other.Rings.Count*100+Other.Rings[0].Value; }
public static int CapturedFieldSameCaptured() { List<Ring> a=[new() {Value=19}]; Filled.Rings=a; Filled.Rings=a; a.Add(new()); return Filled.Rings.Count*100+Filled.Rings[0].Value; }
public static int CapturedFieldFieldGrowthAfterReplace() { var a=Filled.Rings; Filled.Rings=[]; a.Add(new() {Value=29}); return Filled.Rings.Count*100+Filled.Rings[0].Value; }
public static int CapturedFieldFieldDifferentLength() { var a=Filled.Rings; Filled.Rings=[new() {Value=29},new() {Value=39}]; return a.Count*100+a[1].Value; }
public static int CapturedFieldCapturedDifferentLength() { List<Ring> a=[new() {Value=19},new() {Value=39}]; Filled.Rings=a; Filled.Rings=[new() {Value=29}]; return a.Count*100+a[1].Value; }
